title: Oblique Pseudoinverses of Multipliers
summary: Multipliers are operators on a Hilbert space that have been implicitly used in applications throughout the years. Multipliers are defined via three sequences and are mainly used in signal processing and psychoacoustics among many others. They modify a signal in three steps: analysis, term-wise scalar multiplication, and synthesis. While the study of multipliers stemmed from applications, its theory has earned an equally important place in the literature in the last few decades.
